The letter {{AurB|z}} was the twenty-sixth letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet. It was pronounced "zerek", and had the value of /Z/.<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>
